<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <filter id="blurHeader" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="9"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="4" flood-color="#1F2125" flood-opacity=".12"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F8F8F8"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="25" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#1F2125">9:41</text>
    <line x1="326" y1="20" x2="330" y2="20" stroke="#1F2125" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="334" y1="17" x2="334" y2="20" stroke="#1F2125" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="338" y1="14" x2="338" y2="20" stroke="#1F2125" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="342" y1="11" x2="342" y2="20" stroke="#1F2125" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="357" cy="17" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#1F2125" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="360.5" y1="20.5" x2="364" y2="24" stroke="#1F2125" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <rect x="371" y="11" width="17" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#1F2125" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="373" y="13" width="12" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#1F2125"/>
    <line x1="389" y1="15" x2="390" y2="18" stroke="#1F2125" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Blurred app header -->
  <g filter="url(#blurHeader)" opacity=".72">
    <rect x="-15" y="35" width="420" height="86" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="43" cy="78" r="29" fill="#B8EDDC"/>
    <rect x="82" y="60" width="166" height="13" rx="6" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <rect x="82" y="82" width="108" height="9" rx="4" fill="#E8EAEB"/>
    <circle cx="345" cy="78" r="18" fill="#D8E0F3"/>
  </g>

  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="35" width="390" height="86" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".78"/>
    <circle cx="43" cy="78" r="24" fill="#66D9B3"/>
    <circle cx="43" cy="70" r="8" fill="#009A67"/>
    <ellipse cx="43" cy="87" rx="13" ry="8" fill="#009A67"/>
    <text x="82" y="84" font-family="Inter" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#1F2125">Community</text>
    <circle cx="345" cy="78" r="18" fill="#F0FBF8"/>
    <line x1="337" y1="78" x2="353" y2="78" stroke="#009A67" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="345" y1="70" x2="345" y2="86" stroke="#009A67" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="120" x2="390" y2="120" stroke="#F3F5F6" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Empty state -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="195" cy="353" r="68" fill="#F0FBF8"/>
    <rect x="164" y="322" width="62" height="48" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#B8EDDC" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="176,370 184,359 193,370" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#B8EDDC" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="181" cy="342" r="4" fill="#66D9B3"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="342" r="4" fill="#66D9B3"/>
    <circle cx="209" cy="342" r="4" fill="#66D9B3"/>
    <line x1="178" y1="353" x2="212" y2="353" stroke="#D8E0F3" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="195" y="454" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#1F2125">Nothing here yet</text>
    <text x="195" y="480" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#777777">Start a conversation with your community.</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="127" y="510" width="136" height="52" rx="16" fill="#009A67"/>
      <text x="195" y="542" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Explore groups</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation shadow and surface -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="0" y="764" width="390" height="80" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
  <line x1="0" y1="764" x2="390" y2="764" stroke="#F3F5F6" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Home selected -->
  <g>
    <rect x="27" y="775" width="68" height="30" rx="16" fill="#F0FBF8"/>
    <polygon points="61,780 51,788 51,798 57,798 57,792 65,792 65,798 71,798 71,788" fill="#009A67"/>
    <polyline points="50,788 61,779 72,788" fill="none" stroke="#009A67" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="61" y="827" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#009A67">Home</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Discover -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="151" cy="788" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#878B90" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="158" y1="795" x2="165" y2="802" stroke="#878B90" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="151" y="827" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#777777">Discover</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Activity -->
  <g>
    <rect x="229" y="780" width="17" height="16" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#878B90" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="233,796 237,801 240,796" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#878B90" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <circle cx="234" cy="788" r="1.5" fill="#878B90"/>
    <circle cx="239" cy="788" r="1.5" fill="#878B90"/>
    <circle cx="244" cy="788" r="1.5" fill="#878B90"/>
    <text x="237" y="827" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#777777">Activity</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Profile -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="329" cy="785" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#878B90" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="329" cy="798" rx="11" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#878B90" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="329" y="827" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#777777">Profile</text>
  </g>
</svg>
